classification_contract.owned_resource: Reference/template/script/credit file co-located in the owning skill. Must travel with its full directory.

classification_contract.runtime_capability: Subagents, browser/file opener, authenticated tracker CLI, git worktrees, test runner or web reading. These are capabilities, not inferred named-agent files.
